specification.title: Layer Domain Records
specification.goal: stable layer ID, label, color, visibility and lock state
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Document, EntityID, FeatureID, layers, blocks/instances, metadata đá và tham chiếu đối tượng.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo UI quản lý Layers tại đây.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Layer Domain Records” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

plugin_sdk_v1_layers.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_layers.scope: Layer domain records: SDK v1 lists layers with name, colour and effective visible/selectable/locked/current flags (including the command's staged layer records), creates a layer with an optional make-current, and updates one layer's name/colour/flags in the command's transaction.
limitations: Partial scope only: this entry does not close the L3.
Output into a layer created by the same command is admitted; a layer whose flags change in that command still cannot receive output.
Groups, blocks/instances, change notification and snapshot/restore remain open.

plugin_sdk_v1_layer_order.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_layer_order.scope: layer_order returns document.layer_order bottom-to-top and appends a layer created by the same command; read-only.

plugin_sdk_v1_clear_current_layer.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_clear_current_layer.scope: clear_current_layer stages SetCurrent { None } only when a current layer is set; layer records untouched; no-op stages no mutation; Undo restores.

plugin_sdk_v1_layer_info.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_layer_info.scope: layer_info returns one LayerInfo from the shared list mapping; host tests prove equality with the list and the unknown-id refusal.

plugin_sdk_v1_layer_info_native.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_layer_info_native.scope: LayerInfoDemo reads a layer created by LayerDemo through the packaged plugin; the DLL test asserts id/current/locked and the 35-test native suite passes.

sdk_export_plan.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
